description: Run and troubleshoot `bun run beep qa` recording sessions: record / extract / report subcommands, lane choice (playwright recordVideo vs OBS obs-websocket against real Chrome), OBS provisioning (websocket enable, PipeWire portal restore-token, scene setup), and collector/witness debugging. Use when a QA capture will not start, produces no events, records a black window, or you must pick a recording lane. The loop protocol itself lives in `browser-qa-loop`; this skill is the machinery under it.
